title: Precision Slate: Unified quant artifact onboarding and regression telemetry orchestrator
creator: Ava Thompson
description: Build a unified ingestion and verification pipeline for quantized model artifacts (INT8 / FP8 / GPTQ / AWQ) that enforces an immutable artifact fingerprint (precision-slate), emits standardized telemetry for statistical regression detection, and automates staged rollouts with automatic rollback triggers. The goal is to reduce manual validation overhead for model onboarding, lower time-to-pin for production variants, and surface regressions early via hypothesis-test-based telemetry rather than ad-hoc thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: A standardized artifact schema (precision-slate v1) accepted by the ingest API and stored with a deterministic fingerprint (sha256) is implemented

Onboarding job validates model binary + quant metadata and emits the agreed telemetry fields (latency_p50, latency_p95, token_throughput, perplexity_estimate, sample_nll) to the onboarding metrics stream

Regression detector runs a configurable two-sided test (Wilcoxon rank-sum by default) comparing canary traffic to baseline using sliding windows and raises a signal when p < 0.01 and effect size exceeds configured threshold
A server-side rollback policy is implemented that marks a pinned variant as traffic-blocked and opens a follow-up ticket when regression signal is confirmed by enrichment checks
Documentation for the precision-slate format, onboarding checklist, and operator runbook exists in Confluence and is linked from the ticket
implementation_steps: Define precision-slate schema: artifact binary locator, quant backend tag (INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ), quant hyperparameters, kernel-compatibility hints, training calibration set fingerprint, latency/accuracy smoke-test spec
Implement ingest API endpoint that stores artifact + fingerprint and enqueues a validation job
Validation job: run deterministic smoke harness (fixed prompts), collect token-level latency and nll estimates, produce a compact telemetry bundle
Instrument onboarding telemetry pipeline (kafka topic) with schema registry and add parsers to the regression service
Implement regression detector service with configurable stats engines (Wilcoxon + bootstrap CI) and enrichment guards (synthetic prompt pattern checks)
Wire rollout controller: staged percentage ramp, automatic pause on signal, and a manual override path with audit logging
Add UI hooks in Console rollout page to display precision-slate fingerprint, validation summary, and regression trendline
Write Confluence runbook and handoff notes for SRE and Solutions Engineering

notes: Trade-offs considered: aggressive statistical thresholds reduce missed regressions but increase ops noise; we prefer enrichment + effect-size gating to reduce false positives.
Decision: use non-parametric Wilcoxon as default because token-level metrics are heavy-tailed and sometimes multimodal across prompts.
Follow-ups: integrate with Evaluate service to run a small reference eval on new artifacts and store deterministic quality fingerprints (future work)
Operational concern: must ensure telemetry sampling does not add token-level latency overhead; use lightweight counters and offload heavy computations to async batch jobs.
